title.zh: 将北伊罗戈省帕苏金市镇巴图利村更名为圣伊西德罗村的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Barrio Batuli, Municipality of Pasuquin, Province of Ilocos Norte, to Barrio San Isidro
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Barrio Batuli, Municipality of Pasuquin, Province of Ilocos Norte, to Barrio San Isidro
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Barrio Batuli, Thị trấn Pasuquin, Tỉnh Ilocos Norte thành Barrio San Isidro
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อบารริโอ Batuli, เทศบาล Pasuquin, จังหวัด Ilocos Norte เป็นบารริโอ San Isidro
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Barrio Batuli, Kotamadya Pasuquin, Provinsi Ilocos Norte menjadi Barrio San Isidro
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Barrio Batuli, Perbandaran Pasuquin, Wilayah Ilocos Norte menjadi Barrio San Isidro

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1969/ra_5587_1969.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Barrio Batuli in the Municipality of Pasuquin, Province of Ilocos Norte, is hereby changed to Barrio San Isidro.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 21, 1969.
